independent_question: do mechanically defined same-target intersections concentrate material extreme-open propensity beyond each already-retained constituent state rather than merely inherit constituent significance
candidate_construction_rule: all two-way intersections among same-target P1 survivors only

bucket_edges.rule: reuse exact 2015-2017 feature-only tercile edges from P0 carrier; no refit on 2018-2020 or event-conditioned subsets

primary_parent_comparison.rest: candidate-specific eligible PARENT cohort minus the intersection
primary_parent_comparison.BH_family: one complete 3-candidate family separately for EXTREME_UP and EXTREME_DOWN

incremental_constituent_comparisons.reason: comparisons are disjoint and directly test whether the intersection contains extra concentration beyond each constituent's non-overlap portion
incremental_constituent_comparisons.BH_family: for each target, all 6 incremental comparisons = 3 intersections x 2 constituent-exclusive comparators

effect_gates.interpretation: P3 must add consumer-relevant concentration rather than merely reproduce P1

promotion_rule: a P3 candidate survives only if every sample, parent-materiality, primary inference, both incremental constituent inference, BH and annual stability gate passes
if_no_P3_survivor: close P3 without rescue; retain the six P1 univariate states as the only current DEV progression material and proceed to rule-packaging design only from those P1 states under a separate identity
if_P3_survivor: retain exact intersection state as P3 DEV progression material; no reusable validation or product promotion is automatic
